decision: Owner decision 2026-10-27 (issue #39, comment 6440801434, item 2): read-only discovery defaults to control-plane metadata; application data and secret contents are excluded; any exception needs an explicit scope and purpose.

cdkStackReads.why: CDK engine: describe-stacks in the preview and qualification, describe-stack-resources for the blueprint after an apply (src/apply/engines/cdk.ts).

independentObservation.why: The verifier after an apply and after a cleanup: cloudcontrol get-resource and resourcegroupstaggingapi get-resources (src/observe/aws-cli.ts, src/observe/verify.ts).

previewDiscovery.why: The Preview discovery reads under DISCOVERY (src/providers/aws/discover.ts, src/tools/broker.ts). sts get-caller-identity needs no permission.

cloudControlReadHandlers.why: The read-handler permissions of each type the verifier reads through Cloud Control (CLOUD_CONTROL_TYPES in src/observe/verify.ts), from the CloudFormation resource provider schemas. AWS::Lambda::Function is excluded: its read handler returns environment variables and needs kms:Decrypt.

costStatus.why: The read-only cost status (src/cost/status.ts) through the broker's cost reads (src/tools/aws-cost-reads.ts): budgets with their notifications and subscribers, Data Exports with their executions, and the user-defined cost-allocation tags. The unit's tags are read with tag:GetResources, already allowed above. Owner direction 2026-10-31, issue #39 comment 6536926009, plan item 4.
costStatus.scope: Every budget, Data Exports export and cost-allocation tag key in the account. budgets:ViewBudget is AWS's one IAM action for DescribeBudgets, DescribeNotificationsForBudget and DescribeSubscribersForNotification: it returns each budget's configuration, its calculated actual and forecasted spend, and the subscriber addresses the budget's owner configured (email addresses or SNS topic ARNs). The Data Exports reads return each export's configuration and execution status, never the exported data. ce:ListCostAllocationTags returns tag keys and their activation status, never tag values or cost data.
costStatus.purpose: Show the cost baseline's budget, recipients, cost-allocation tag activation and export delivery state, every value labeled OBSERVED, ESTIMATE or UNKNOWN. The status is read-only and never gates ACT.

recordedExceptions.why: Two read-handler permissions that return more than configuration. They cannot be scoped to the pilot's own resources: a blueprint names its buckets and topics freely, and the pilot apply sets no unit tag yet. They are recorded here as exceptions to the owner decision, with scope and purpose, for the owner to accept.
recordedExceptions.scope: Every S3 bucket and SNS topic in the account (Resource "*"). s3:ListBucket returns object key names, never object contents. sns:ListSubscriptionsByTopic returns subscription endpoints (email addresses, phone numbers, HTTPS URLs), never messages.
recordedExceptions.purpose: The Cloud Control read handlers of AWS::S3::Bucket and AWS::SNS::Topic require them, so the verifier cannot confirm that a run-created bucket or topic exists or is gone without them; s3:ListBucket also authorizes HeadBucket.

logEvents.why: Log events, query results and database log files.

secretsAndParameters.why: Secret values, parameter values, decryption, connection passwords, and settings that carry environment variables, user data or code.

executionData.why: Workflow input and output, command output, and user records (PII).

apiKeyValues.why: API Gateway API key values. apigateway:GET is one action for every API Gateway read, so the deny names the key paths only; the rest of API Gateway configuration stays readable.

functionInvocation.why: Running a function is not a read. An aws_lambda_invocation data source or ephemeral resource invokes a function while terraform plan runs as DISCOVERY (review 6453264963 of #322, N4; lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl added by the review of #327, N2). None of the accepted managed policies is meant to grant these, and this deny holds even if one does. No exception lifts it: discovery_data_read_exceptions may only name actions the blanket deny lists.
